g.text: Frequency sensitivity at fixed 4 x 1 q sampling and range
All three runs converge the original six screens. 1201 uses a native17 continuation.
1201 vs 901: +0.6851%; 1201 vs 601: +0.5863%. The 2% target is diagnostic, not an SCBA gate.
This supports the sampled frequency sensitivity only; it does not establish full q-mesh or physical-interface validity.
Fitted research model (2.14147% bulk FC3 fit error). Model/grid SCBA convergence; interface and full q-mesh validity remain open.
